description: Kenwood TH-D74 clone image: 1000 memories in 6-per-256-byte groups, flags, names, and menu settings

groups.label: Identity
groups.description: Menu 500 stores the callsign and SSID as separate text. The callsign is 6 bytes at 0x1200, NUL-padded. The SSID is the literal suffix, including the hyphen (for example -7), in 3 NUL-padded bytes at 0x1206. It is not a 0-15 index. A shorter callsign does not shift the SSID.

groups.label: Identity
groups.description: Menu 610 is an 8-character callsign at 0x2B1 and a 4-character memo at 0x2B9, both space-padded. The radio shows them as CALL/MEMO.

ui.label: Scan skip
ui.description: Skips this memory during scan. The channel stays in memory and can still be selected directly.

ui.label: Memory group
ui.description: Memory group this channel belongs to. Group scan and group link use this number.

ui.label: Tuning step (kHz)
ui.description: How far the frequency moves for each click of the tuning control, in kHz.

ui.label: Mode
ui.description: Modulation for this memory. FM and DV are the usual voice modes. AM, SSB, and CW are for the bands that support them.

ui.label: Duplex
ui.description: Repeater shift. Blank transmits on the receive frequency. + transmits above it and − transmits below it.

ui.label: D-STAR squelch
ui.description: D-STAR digital squelch. Blank hears every digital signal. Code opens only for a matching digital code. Callsign opens only for a matching callsign.

ui.label: URCALL
ui.description: D-STAR Your Call (URCALL). CQCQCQ calls anyone. A station callsign calls that station. A repeater gateway callsign routes the transmission.

ui.label: RPT1
ui.description: D-STAR repeater 1 callsign, usually the local repeater you transmit to, with its module letter in the eighth position.

ui.label: RPT2
ui.description: D-STAR repeater 2 callsign, usually the gateway or the distant repeater, with its module letter in the eighth position.

ui.label: D-STAR code
ui.description: Digital code squelch number used when D-STAR squelch is set to Code. Both stations must use the same code.

ui.label: Group name
ui.description: Name shown for this memory group.

ui.label: My Callsign
ui.description: D-STAR My Callsign, up to 8 characters. Stored space-padded. The radio shows it with the memo as CALL/MEMO.

ui.label: Callsign memo
ui.description: Four-character note stored immediately after My Callsign. The radio shows the pair as CALL/MEMO. Edited text is space-padded.

ui.label: Beat Shift
ui.description: Shifts the radio's internal beat so a birdie moves off the frequency you are listening to. Measured index 0 is Type 1 through index 7 is Type 8.

ui.label: TX Inhibit
ui.description: Blocks the transmitter so the radio cannot be keyed. Receive still works.

ui.label: Time-Out Timer
ui.description: Ends a transmission that stays keyed longer than this. The steps run from 0.5 minutes to 5.0 minutes in half-minute steps, then 10 minutes. Clone images confirm index 0x09 is 5.0 min and 0x0A is 10 min, which matches this list.

ui.label: Mic Sensitivity
ui.description: Microphone sensitivity. Clone images confirm 0x00 High, 0x01 Medium, and 0x02 Low.

ui.label: SSB High Cut
ui.description: SSB receive high-cut frequency. Clone images confirm 0x00 = 2.2 kHz, 0x01 = 2.4 kHz, 0x02 = 2.6 kHz, 0x03 = 2.8 kHz, and 0x04 = 3.0 kHz.

ui.label: CW Width
ui.description: CW receive filter width. Measured on the radio: 0x00 = 0.3 kHz, 0x01 = 0.5 kHz, 0x02 = 1.0 kHz, 0x03 = 1.5 kHz, and 0x04 = 2.0 kHz.

ui.label: AM High Cut
ui.description: AM receive high-cut frequency. Measured on the radio: 0x00 = 3.0 kHz, 0x01 = 4.5 kHz, 0x02 = 6.0 kHz, and 0x03 = 7.5 kHz.

ui.label: Scan Resume
ui.description: What analog scan does after it stops on a signal. Time resumes after the restart timer. Carrier resumes when the signal drops. Seek stops and stays. Digital scan resume is menu 131.

ui.label: Resume (Digital)
ui.description: What digital scan does after it stops on a signal. Measured on the radio: 0 = Time, 1 = Carrier, 2 = Seek.

ui.label: Time Restart
ui.description: How long Time scan stays on a signal before it resumes, in seconds. The radio stores the number itself, 1 through 10. The manual default is 5.

ui.label: Carrier Restart
ui.description: How long Carrier scan waits after the signal drops before it resumes, in seconds. The radio stores the number itself, 1 through 10. The manual default is 2.

ui.label: Scan Auto Backlight
ui.description: Turns the backlight on when scan stops on a signal. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: Auto Offset
ui.description: Applies the standard repeater offset for the current band. Measured by switching the menu from On to Off: 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: CALL Key
ui.description: What the CALL key sends. 0 is CALL and 1 is 1750 Hz.

ui.label: 1750Hz TX Hold
ui.description: Keeps transmitting the 1750 Hz tone while the CALL key stays pressed. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: VOX
ui.description: Keys the transmitter from microphone audio. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: VOX Gain
ui.description: How loud the microphone audio must be before VOX keys the transmitter. The byte is the level itself, 0 through 9.

ui.label: VOX Delay
ui.description: How long the radio stays keyed after you stop talking. Measured index 0 is 250 ms through 3000 ms.

ui.label: TX on Busy
ui.description: Allows transmit while the channel is busy. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: DTMF Encode Speed
ui.description: How long each DTMF digit is sent. 0 is 50 ms, 1 is 100 ms, and 2 is 150 ms.

ui.label: Pause Time
ui.description: Pause between DTMF digits. Index 0 is 100 ms through 2000 ms.

ui.label: DTMF TX Hold
ui.description: Holds the transmitter after the DTMF string. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: CW Pitch
ui.description: CW sidetone pitch. Clone images confirm 0x01 = 500 Hz, 0x04 = 800 Hz, and 0x06 = 1000 Hz. Those measurements confirm 100 Hz steps from 400 Hz at 0x00. The remaining steps follow that confirmed pattern.

ui.label: CW Reverse
ui.description: Swaps the CW sideband. 0 is Normal and 1 is Reverse.

ui.label: QSO Log
ui.description: Records QSOs in the radio log. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: Recall Method
ui.description: Which memories the channel knob walks through. 0 is All Bands. 1 is Current Band.

ui.label: TX Monitor
ui.description: Lets you hear your own transmitted audio. Stored as 1 On and 0 Off.

ui.label: Backlight Control
ui.description: When the display backlight turns on. Manual follows the backlight key. On stays lit. Auto lights while you operate the radio, then follows the backlight timer. Auto (DC-IN) stays lit on external power and follows Auto on the battery.

ui.label: LCD Brightness
ui.description: Display brightness. Clone images confirm 0x00 Low, 0x01 Medium, and 0x02 High.

ui.label: Key Beep
ui.description: Beeps when a key is pressed.

ui.label: Battery Saver
ui.description: How long the receiver sleeps between checks while the squelch is closed. Off keeps it awake. Longer times save more battery and can miss the start of a short call.

ui.label: Auto Power Off
ui.description: Turns the radio off after this long with no keypress or tuning. Off disables it. Scanning keeps the radio awake.

ui.label: Cursor Shift
ui.description: How long the radio waits before moving the text cursor. Clone images confirm 0x00 Off, 0x01 = 1.0 s, 0x02 = 1.5 s, and 0x03 = 2.0 s.

ui.label: DTMF Keys Lock
ui.description: Stops the keypad from sending DTMF tones while transmitting. Clone images confirm 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: Speed/Distance
ui.description: Units for speed and distance. Clone images confirm 0x00 = mi/h, 0x01 = km/h, and 0x02 = knots. The manual's printed order depends on the region and does not match these bytes.

ui.label: Power-on Message
ui.description: Text shown for a couple of seconds when the radio is turned on. Up to 16 characters. Edited text is NUL-padded.

ui.label: My Callsign
ui.description: APRS callsign, up to 6 characters, NUL-padded. The SSID is the next field and does not move when this callsign is shorter than 6 characters.

ui.label: SSID
ui.description: APRS SSID as stored text, including the hyphen, for example -7 or -15. This is not a 0-15 index. Three bytes, NUL-padded. Together with the 6-character callsign this fills menu 500, which allows 9 characters.

ui.label: Icon
ui.description: APRS symbol, stored as the table character and the symbol code. Radio is \Y and RV is /R. The list is the TH-D74 manual icon names mapped to the public APRS symbol table (symbolsX.txt and symbols-new.txt). A symbol that is not in the list is left as those two characters. Edited text is NUL-padded.

ui.label: Shift/Offset
ui.description: Includes the repeater shift and offset in APRS QSY information. 0 is Off and 1 is On.

ui.label: QSY Limit Distance
ui.description: Farthest station the radio will tune from QSY data. The manual steps are Off, then 10 through 2500. The byte stores that distance in tens of miles: 0 is Off and 246 is 2460 mi. The choices are shown in miles.

ui.label: Slow Rate
ui.description: SmartBeaconing transmit interval at low speed, in minutes. The manual range is 1 to 100. The default in the manual is 30. The byte is the number of minutes.

ui.label: Waypoint Format
ui.description: Waypoint sentence format. Measured bytes are 0 NMEA and 2 KENWOOD. MAGELLAN is 1 from the manual order between those two.

ui.label: Position Limit
ui.description: Ignores stations farther than this. The manual steps are Off, then 10 through 2500. The byte stores that distance in tens of miles: 0 is Off and 248 is 2480 mi. The choices are shown in miles.

ui.label: Others
ui.description: Receives other packet types. Bit 6 (0x40), assumed from the manual list. Bit 7 is unused and is left unchanged.

ui.label: 1-WAY
ui.description: Receives one-way trackers. Bit 5 (0x20). Manual order places 1-WAY on this bit of the measured 0x20 and 0x04 pair.

ui.label: NAVITRA
ui.description: Receives NAVITRA stations. Bit 4 (0x10), assumed from the manual list.

ui.label: Object
ui.description: Receives object packets. Bit 3 (0x08), assumed from the manual list.

ui.label: Mobile
ui.description: Receives mobile stations. Bit 2 (0x04). Manual order places Mobile on this bit of the measured 0x20 and 0x04 pair.

ui.label: Digipeater
ui.description: Receives digipeaters. Bit 1 (0x02), assumed from the manual list.

ui.label: Weather
ui.description: Receives weather stations. Bit 0 (0x01), assumed from the manual list.

ui.label: Bulletin Group Code
ui.description: Bulletin group codes, up to 6 codes of 5 characters, separated by commas. The manual allows 0-9, A-Z, comma, and hyphen. The field is 35 bytes, which holds 6 codes plus the commas between them. Empty storage is 35 zero bytes. Edited text is NUL-padded.
